scope: Single host, local generated fixtures, original workload replicas; no upstream interoperability or deployment certification.

method.selection: Minimum mean calibration cold construction+execution+shutdown plus warm execution; same search grid for both engines
method.cpu: POSIX getrusage SELF + waited CHILDREN delta for executor lifecycle, including sampling/fixture threads; unavailable on Windows
method.warm: Second pass in same pool; reused immutable fixture inputs, fresh per-invocation caches/outputs; OS/library caches uncontrolled
method.memory: 10 ms sampled absolute aggregate process-tree RSS including fixture server, shared pages may double-count
method.intelligent: Calibration-selected explicit thread/process hints; fixed admission at interval 0, opt-in predictive otherwise. No automatic workload replay.
method.tuning_budget: Same backend/worker/batch grid; additional intelligent profiling modes only when explicitly requested, costs reported
method.comparison: Held-out time of calibration-selected stdlib divided by separately calibration-selected intelligent; no held-out oracle tuning
